content: The Executor successfully completed the HWPX (Hancom Office) document transformation by correctly handling XML-specific challenges. Key successful patterns included: 1) Merging split `<hp:t>` elements within paragraphs to resolve placeholders that were fragmented across XML tags. 2) Using regex to identify and remove layout-cache elements like `<hp:lineSegArray>` which, if left intact after text modification, cause character overlapping in HWPX viewers. 3) Implementing a date-diff logic for month spans that treats '2025.01 ~ 2025.03' as 3 months. The script effectively normalized budget strings and repacked the ZIP structure required for the .hwpx extension.
